# Official Klipper inputs for the BLTouch catalog

These 14 CFG files are byte-exact official inputs at
`fe4eb8650bd7de4c2100a14eaf09b0965c430e29`; all are also unchanged at
`ce7002bedf37e938bb483572949f3703ac6476cb`.
They cover every official filename matched by the 15 legacy catalog keys in the audit.
Three keys had no matching official filename: creality-v4.2.2, mks-sgen-l, mks-gen-l.
Absence of an active conflict is not evidence of a BLTouch connector.
Only the four exact Octopus examples with explicit official BLTouch sections
remain automatic catalog entries. Other boards require manual wiring selection.
